CREATE TABLE `demo_mart`.`dim_user_profile_df`(
  `user_id` BIGINT COMMENT 'surrogate user key',
  `user_name` STRING COMMENT 'display name',
  `register_channel` STRING COMMENT 'acquisition channel',
  `city_code` STRING COMMENT 'city code',
  `is_active` BIGINT COMMENT '1 active 0 inactive')
COMMENT 'user profile dimension'
PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING COMMENT 'date', `hour` STRING COMMENT 'hour')
ROW FORMAT SERDE
  'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'
STORED AS
  INPUTFORMAT 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.MapredParquetInputFormat'
  OUTPUTFORMAT 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.MapredParquetOutputFormat'
TBLPROPERTIES (
  'transient_lastDdlTime' = '1700000000')

CREATE TABLE `demo_mart`.`dwd_order_event_di`(
  `order_id` BIGINT COMMENT 'order id',
  `user_id` BIGINT COMMENT 'buyer id',
  `item_id` BIGINT COMMENT 'item id',
  `pay_amount` DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT 'paid amount',
  `discount_rate` DOUBLE COMMENT 'discount ratio',
  `order_time` TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'order create time',
  `order_status` STRING COMMENT 'order status')
COMMENT 'order event detail'
PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING COMMENT 'date')
STORED AS ORC

CREATE TABLE `demo_mart`.`dwd_item_detail_df`(
  `item_id` BIGINT COMMENT 'item id',
  `item_name` STRING COMMENT 'item name',
  `category_path` ARRAY<STRING> COMMENT 'category hierarchy',
  `attr_kv` MAP<STRING,STRING> COMMENT 'attribute map',
  `price_info` STRUCT<currency:STRING,amount:DECIMAL(18,2)> COMMENT 'price struct')
COMMENT 'item detail dimension'
PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING)
STORED AS PARQUET

CREATE VIEW `demo_mart`.`dws_user_stats_view`(
  `user_id` COMMENT 'user id',
  `order_cnt` COMMENT 'order count',
  `p_date`,
  `gmv` COMMENT 'gross merchandise value')
COMMENT 'user daily stats view'
AS SELECT user_id, count(1) AS order_cnt, p_date, sum(pay_amount) AS gmv
FROM demo_mart.dwd_order_event_di GROUP BY user_id, p_date

CREATE TABLE `demo_mart`.`ads_channel_report_df`(
  `channel` STRING COMMENT 'channel name',
  `user_cnt` BIGINT COMMENT 'user count',
  `gmv` DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT 'gmv')
COMMENT 'channel report'
PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING)
STORED AS PARQUET

CREATE TABLE `demo_mart`.`dim_product_category_df`(
  `category_id` BIGINT COMMENT 'category id',
  `category_name` STRING COMMENT 'category name',
  `parent_id` BIGINT COMMENT 'parent category id')
COMMENT 'product category dimension'
PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING)
STORED AS PARQUET
